name: Meikyuu no Otogibanashi Tale of the Labyrinth－Dark Princess－
original_name: 迷宮のお伽話 Tale of the Labyrinth－Dark Princess－
source:
A chronicle of the machinations of villains in the land of fairytales.

A land where fairytales gather is ruled over by a man called the Villain King. His lackey, the villain protagonist, is ordered by him to destroy a certain tale...
